welcome_series.subject: Welcome to the Inner Circle | Pawché
welcome_series.preview_text: Your dog lives for luxury too. Welcome to The Club.
welcome_series.body_html:
The Sovereign Standard of Canine Living

Welcome to Pawché. You have entered a realm where canine lifestyle meets high-fashion editorial excellence. We are delighted to have you and your companion as members of The Club.

At Pawché, we believe that true luxury isn't just for owners—it’s for our most loyal heirs too. From the obsidian hues of The Wardrobe to the radiant gold of The Vault, every piece in our collection is curated for those who demand the best.

As a token of our appreciation for joining the Inner Circle, please enjoy 10% off your first acquisition.

CODE: CLUB10

Explore our latest arrivals and begin your journey into a life lived beautifully.

Explore the Collections

welcome_series.subject: Curating a Life of Opulence
welcome_series.preview_text: Discover the art of the acquisition with The Vault.
welcome_series.body_html:
The Art of the Acquisition

A life of luxury is defined by the details. Today, we invite you to explore The Vault—our most exclusive curated range of dog jewelry and statement collars.

Whether it's a crystal-encrusted gala collar or a gold-tone heirloom pendant, these pieces are designed to turn every promenade into a celebrated event.

Featured Collections:
• The Wardrobe: Couture Tailoring
• The Penthouse Suite: Architectural Rest
• The Spa: Rituals of Restoration

Step Into The Vault

post_purchase.subject: A Celebrated Event: Your Order is Confirmed
post_purchase.preview_text: Welcome to the world of Pawché. Your dog thanks you.
post_purchase.body_html:
Excellence Confirmed

Thank you for choosing Pawché. Your acquisition is more than a purchase—it is a commitment to a lifestyle of opulence and aesthetic brilliance.

Our concierge team is now preparing your items. Please allow 1-3 business days for processing as we ensure every detail meets our golden standard. Once dispatched, you will receive a tracking number to monitor your order's journey (typically 5-10 business days).

We invite you to share your Pawché moment on Instagram or TikTok and tag @pawche. We love seeing our pieces in their new homes.

Welcome to the family.
